questions.prompt: Which document did King John seal at Runnymede in 1215?
questions.fact: It was annulled by the Pope within ten weeks. Its lasting power came from later reissues, not from the original sealing at Runnymede.

questions.prompt: What is the hardest naturally occurring mineral?
questions.fact: Diamond and graphite are both pure carbon. The entire difference is in how the atoms are arranged.

questions.prompt: How many quarters are in a professional basketball game?
questions.fact: Four quarters of 12 minutes in the NBA. College basketball uses two halves instead.
